EMA_CROSS.name: EMA Crossover
EMA_CROSS.details: Buy when Fast EMA crosses above Slow EMA; Sell when Fast EMA crosses below Slow EMA.

SMA_GOLDEN_CROSS.name: SMA Golden Cross
SMA_GOLDEN_CROSS.details: Classic long-term trend strategy. Buy: SMA 50 crosses above SMA 200.

HULL_MA_CROSS.name: Hull MA Crossover
HULL_MA_CROSS.details: Fast/Slow crossover using the smoother Hull Moving Average (HMA).

TMA_THRESHOLD.name: Triangular MA Threshold
TMA_THRESHOLD.details: Buy/Sell when price crosses above/below a single Triangular MA.

VWMA_TREND.name: Volume Weighted MA Trend
VWMA_TREND.details: Enter when price crosses above a single VWMA; exit when it crosses below.

RSI_CLASSIC.name: RSI Classic Overbought/Oversold
RSI_CLASSIC.details: Buy when RSI crosses above Oversold (30); Sell when RSI crosses below Overbought (70).

STOCHASTIC_CROSS.name: Stochastic K/D Crossover
STOCHASTIC_CROSS.details: Buy when %K crosses above %D in the oversold zone; Sell when %K crosses below %D in the overbought zone.

MACD_ZERO_CROSS.name: MACD Zero Line Crossover
MACD_ZERO_CROSS.details: Buy when MACD crosses above the zero line; Sell when MACD crosses below the zero line.

CCI_THRESHOLD.name: Commodity Channel Index Threshold
CCI_THRESHOLD.details: Buy when CCI crosses above 100; Sell when CCI crosses below -100.

PPO_CROSS.name: Percentage Price Oscillator Crossover
PPO_CROSS.details: Buy when PPO line crosses above PPO signal line.

BBANDS_BREAKOUT.name: Bollinger Bands Breakout
BBANDS_BREAKOUT.details: Buy when price closes above Upper Band; Sell when price closes below Lower Band (Volatility Breakout).

BBANDS_REVERSAL.name: Bollinger Bands Reversal
BBANDS_REVERSAL.details: Buy when price touches/crosses the Lower Band; Sell when price touches/crosses the Upper Band (Mean Reversion).

ATR_CHANNEL.name: ATR Trailing Stop Channel
ATR_CHANNEL.details: Buy when price crosses above (Close + ATR * Multiplier); Sell when price crosses below (Close - ATR * Multiplier).

CHANDELIER_EXIT.name: Chandelier Exit
CHANDELIER_EXIT.details: Uses ATR to set a trailing stop. Exit (Sell) when price closes below the Chandelier Exit Long line.

DONCHIAN_BREAKOUT.name: Donchian Channel Breakout
DONCHIAN_BREAKOUT.details: Buy when price breaks the Upper Channel; Sell when price breaks the Lower Channel (Momentum).

ADX_TREND_ENTRY.name: ADX Trend Confirmation
ADX_TREND_ENTRY.details: Buy when +DI crosses above -DI AND ADX is above a confirmation threshold.

inputs.name: adx_threshold
inputs.description: ADX minimum level for trend confirmation (Recommended: 15-40)

OBV_BREAKOUT.name: On-Balance Volume Breakout
OBV_BREAKOUT.details: Buy when OBV closes above its MA; Sell when OBV closes below its MA.

MFI_OVERSOLD.name: Money Flow Index Overbought/Oversold
MFI_OVERSOLD.details: Buy when MFI crosses above Oversold (20); Sell when MFI crosses below Overbought (80).

CMF_ZERO_CROSS.name: Chaikin Money Flow Zero Cross
CMF_ZERO_CROSS.details: Buy when CMF crosses above the zero line; Sell when CMF crosses below the zero line.

COMPOSITE_FILTER.name: Composite Filter (AND/OR)
COMPOSITE_FILTER.details: Combines signals from 2 or more strategies using boolean logic.
